name: 1stCollab
description:
1stCollab is an influencer marketing platform where brands discover creators, run campaigns, manage contracts, and track campaign performance. This connector brings that workflow into Claude.

Connect your brand account to work through campaign operations conversationally:

Pipeline and priorities — See what needs attention across every campaign in one prioritized queue: pending negotiations, contracts awaiting action, content in review, and deliverables running late.

Negotiations — Review creator applications and offers with full context on rates, deliverables, and prior collaborations, then respond individually or work through a campaign's pipeline with a recommended plan.

Contracts and deliverables — Track contract terms and lifecycle state, adjust deliverable timelines, and handle fulfillment steps as they come due.

Content review — Check submitted scripts and videos against the brief, approve or send back with notes, and request usage rights on completed content.

Creator relationships — Look up whether you've worked with a creator before and where things stand, and message creators directly in the partnership thread.

Campaigns, briefs, and personas — Create and update campaigns, refine creative briefs section by section, and define personas describing the creators you're targeting.

Reporting — Pull views, engagement, clicks, and spend by campaign, plus billing summaries.

Requires a 1stCollab account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add 1stCollab to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 1stCollab to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.1stcollab.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the 1stCollab MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: 1stCollab lists 42 MCP tools, including influencers_configure_repeat_deals, influencers_create_campaign, influencers_create_persona, influencers_delete_persona, influencers_get_billing_summary, influencers_get_brief, influencers_get_campaign_context, influencers_get_campaign_contexts, influencers_get_campaign_report, influencers_get_contract, influencers_get_contracts, and influencers_get_creator_relationship.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to 1stCollab?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to 1stCollab in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
1stCollab requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
1stCollab is developed by 1stCollab. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
